_comment: A CONFIGURED GUARD THAT IS MISSING MUST FAIL THE ACTION, NOT PASS IT. Every registration below resolves its script, runs it through `bash` (never `exec "$script"`, which needs an executable bit that a fresh clone may not have — all seven files here were recorded in git as 100644 until 2026-11-07), and exits 2 with a named message when the file is absent or unreadable. The previous shape was `[ -x "$script" ] && exec "$script" || true`, where a missing guard exited 0 — indistinguishable from a clean pass, and the same `|| true`-on-the-deciding-line family that once turned a missing `jq` binary into two CI watches that printed nothing while the build was red. `scripts/hook_health.py` now fails on both shapes, and `brain-doctor.sh` runs it.

hooks.command: bash -c 'script="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/enforce-workspace-updates.sh"; if [ -r "$script" ]; then exec bash "$script"; fi; echo "GUARD MISSING: .claude/hooks/enforce-workspace-updates.sh is registered in .claude/settings.json but is not readable. Restore it or remove its registration — this blocks rather than passes, because a guard that cannot run has checked nothing." >&2; exit 2'
